The beetle has a distinctively elongated, segmented body with a metallic dark/greyish exoskeleton featuring fine punctate texture. It possesses extremely long, slender orange/red legs and very long filiform antennae. The head features large compound eyes and visible mandibles. The background is a soft-focus vibrant green.
